title: Vibrant Spicy Chinese Apricot Lo Mein
description: A quick and spicy Chinese dish featuring apricot and crunchy lo mein, perfect for a weeknight dinner, this recipe is also Buddhist-temple-friendly as it does not include any animal products.
instructions: Cook the lo mein noodles according to the package instructions and set aside.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, rice vinegar, grated ginger, and red pepper flakes.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the diced apricots to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes or until they start to soften.
Add the cooked lo mein noodles to the skillet and stir to combine with the apricots.
Pour the soy sauce mixture over the noodles and apricots, and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes or until the noodles are well coated.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the lo mein to a serving platter and garnish with sliced scallions.
